summary: Frontend-only regression sweep for react-hooks/exhaustive-deps refactor across 4 components (RevealStage, PubCrawlDialog, NearbyHelp, InstallAppButton). All refactored flows verified end-to-end at the public preview URL. Zero React/JS console errors, zero effect-driven network loops. The primary refactor risk (infinite effects from dependency changes) is not present.
critical_code_review_comments: RevealStage.jsx flourish effect keyed on derived resultId is correct — flourish re-fires once per new pick and cleans up (no accumulation observed).

PubCrawlDialog.jsx: openBadge useCallback deps are stable ([startKey, stops.length, crawlVerified, routeDistance]); allDone-guarded auto-prompt effect fires exactly once and resets on !allDone (promptedRef pattern verified).
PubCrawlDialog.jsx: postCheckin via postCheckinRef prevents watchPosition recreation loops — good pattern.

PubCrawlDialog.jsx line 118 has `fetchCategory` deps [effectiveZip, effectiveCoords, radiusMi, data] — including `data` risks re-creating the callback on every cache write; since it's only called via pickCategory and gated by `data[catId]` cache check it is safe, but consider a functional-set pattern to drop `data` from deps.
NearbyHelp.jsx effectiveCoords useMemo correctly stabilises identity; fetchCategory ran once per category select (verified via network monitor).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL requires dismissing TWO first-visit dialogs (theme welcome via 'ENTER FORK·FATE' button, then guided intro via 'Skip intro' text button). The 'Crawl in reveal actions' path described in the request does NOT exist — Crawl UI is reached by toggling the 'Pub Crawls & more' switch in More ways to play then clicking 'Plan a Crawl'. Pub crawl testids observed: pub-crawl-dialog, crawl-stop-{i}, crawl-checkoff-{i}, crawl-complete-button, crawl-reshuffle-button, crawl-badge-dialog. Nearby Help testids used: nearby-help-trigger, nearby-help-zip-input, nearby-help-tile-<catId>.

detailed_verification.home_load: Loads clean; theme welcome + intro dialogs dismissed without errors.
detailed_verification.deal_flow: ZIP 10001 → Shuffle the Deck → reveal card renders (Capizzi, Pizza $$). data-testid=theme-flourish present (count=1) on Summer theme.
detailed_verification.respin_flourish_refire: Clicked respin-button; new place fetched (+1 /api/places/search + 3 photo calls); flourish count remained 1 (not accumulating), no flicker.
detailed_verification.nearby_help: Sheet opens; ZIP not inherited (sheet-local field is empty as designed). Filled ZIP 10001 → clicked Pharmacy tile → exactly 1 /api/places/essentials call. 4s idle: 0 additional calls. No refetch loop from useMemo(effectiveCoords).
detailed_verification.install_button: data-testid=download-app-button renders in header, click did not crash (no beforeinstallprompt captured in headless so neither native prompt nor iOS dialog appeared — expected).
detailed_verification.crawl_dialog: Plan a Crawl opened pub-crawl-dialog with 6 stops. Complete button disabled and labelled 'Check off all stops to unlock (0/6)'. Checked off stop 0 → button turned green (bg-[#4ADE80]). Badge dialog did NOT auto-open (allDone=false). Reshuffle button in a separate probe run generated a fresh route without errors.
detailed_verification.dev_rare_page: /dev/rare renders (rare-preview-page). data-testid=theme-flourish[data-flourish=dark] present (count=1). Clicking reset-souls kept the dark flourish mounted (remount succeeded).
detailed_verification.console_errors: 0 JS errors, 0 React warnings during the entire session. Only a benign chromestatus.com 'Blocked call to navigator.vibrate' policy notice (headless autoplay/tap gesture requirement) which is unrelated to the refactor.

test_credentials: None required (no auth flows in tested scope).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no regressions found. The dependency-array cleanup in the 4 components is behaviour-preserving under manual + automated verification.
